chapters.title: Tragedy
content: Ken Kaneki is a shy, bookish university student living in Tokyo.
He has a crush on a beautiful girl named Rize Kamishiro who shares his love for literature.
Kaneki convinces Rize to go on a date with him at a local cafe.
The date goes well, and Rize asks Kaneki to walk her home.
Kaneki is excited and nervous about the evening.
Rize reveals her true nature as a ghoul and attacks Kaneki.
She bites into his shoulder and prepares to devour him.
Kaneki is thrown into a desperate struggle for survival.
A steel beam falls from a construction site, crushing Rize.
Kaneki is severely injured and loses consciousness.
He is rushed to the hospital for emergency surgery.
The doctors transplant Rize's organs into Kaneki to save him.
Kaneki survives the surgery but is forever changed.
He wakes up as a half-ghoul, half-human hybrid.

chapters.title: Oddity
content: Kaneki wakes up in the hospital feeling strange and disoriented.
He notices that his body has changed dramatically.
His appetite for normal food has completely vanished.
The smell of human food makes him feel nauseous.
Kaneki tries to eat a burger but spits it out in disgust.
He discovers that he can only stomach human flesh.
Kaneki is horrified by his new cravings and desires.
He tries to resist the hunger, but it becomes unbearable.
Kaneki experiences his first encounter with a ghoul's power.
His right eye transforms into a red and black kakugan.
He can now see ghouls and their hidden world.
Kaneki learns that he is no longer fully human.
He is caught between two worlds, belonging to neither.
Kaneki's life is thrown into complete chaos.

chapters.title: Worst
content: Kaneki wanders the streets of Tokyo, confused and desperate.
He meets a man who offers him help and guidance.
The man is actually a ghoul who wants to eat Kaneki.
Kaneki's new instincts kick in and he defends himself.
He discovers that he has a kagune, a ghoul's weapon.
Kaneki's kagune emerges from his back, shaped like a rinkaku.
He defeats the ghoul but is traumatized by the experience.
Kaneki runs away from the scene, covered in blood.
He realizes that he is now a monster to both humans and ghouls.
Kaneki is approached by a group of ghouls from Anteiku.
They offer him shelter and protection from the CCG.
Kaneki is terrified and suspicious of their intentions.
He has no choice but to trust them.
Kaneki enters the world of ghouls for the first time.

chapters.title: Coffee
content: Kaneki is brought to Anteiku, a coffee shop run by ghouls.
The shop is a safe haven for ghouls in the 20th Ward.
He meets Yoshimura, the kind and wise manager of Anteiku.
Yoshimura explains the rules of the ghoul world to Kaneki.
Kaneki must learn to control his hunger and his powers.
Touka Kirishima, a fierce ghoul, is hostile toward Kaneki.
She warns him that he doesn't belong in their world.
Kaneki is introduced to Hideyoshi Nagachika, his human friend.
Hide comes to Anteiku looking for Kaneki.
Kaneki hides his ghoul nature from his best friend.
The CCG begins investigating the 20th Ward for ghouls.
Kaneki must navigate the dangerous line between worlds.
He learns about the CCG and their ghoul investigators.
Kaneki's new life is fraught with danger and secrets.

chapters.title: Feeding Ground
content: Kaneki struggles to control his hunger for human flesh.
Yoshimura teaches him how to eat human food without disgust.
Kaneki learns about the different types of ghoul kagune.
He meets Nishiki Nishio, a ghoul who despises humans.
Nishiki attacks Kaneki for being a half-breed.
Kaneki is forced to fight for his life again.
His rinkaku kagune proves to be powerful and dangerous.
Touka intervenes and saves Kaneki from Nishiki.
Touka is still cold and distant toward Kaneki.
Kaneki learns that Nishiki has a human girlfriend.
This revelation shocks Kaneki and challenges his views.
He begins to understand the complexities of ghouls.
The CCG continues its investigations in the 20th Ward.
Kaneki realizes he must become stronger to survive.

chapters.title: Homing
content: Kaneki begins working at Anteiku to blend in.
He learns how to make coffee and serve customers.
Kaneki gains the trust of the Anteiku ghouls.
He meets the Fueguchi family, a kind ghoul family.
The Fueguchis are targeted by the CCG investigators.
Kaneki tries to help them escape from the CCG.
The investigators are led by Kureo Mado and Juzo Suzuya.
Mado is a ruthless and sadistic ghoul investigator.
Suzuya is a young investigator with a dark past.
The CCG attacks the Fueguchi family's hideout.
Hinami Fueguchi's mother is killed by Mado.
Kaneki is devastated and furious at the CCG.
He vows to protect Hinami from the investigators.
Kaneki's anger toward the CCG begins to grow.

chapters.title: Deception
content: Kaneki and Touka go to a cemetery to pay respects.
They discover a grave for a ghoul that was killed by the CCG.
Kaneki decides to investigate Mado's activities.
He follows Mado and observes his cruel methods.
Mado collects kagune from dead ghouls to make quinque.
Kaneki is disgusted by Mado's lack of humanity.
He confronts Mado in a dangerous encounter.
Kaneki uses his wits and powers to survive.
He learns that the CCG views ghouls as monsters.
Kaneki begins to question his own humanity.
He is no longer sure where his loyalties lie.
Kaneki's dual nature causes him great pain.
He struggles to find his place in the world.
Kaneki's journey into darkness continues.

chapters.title: Kagune
content: Kaneki learns more about the nature of ghouls and their abilities.
He discovers that his kagune is a rinkaku type.
Rinkaku kagune are powerful but less stable than other types.
Kaneki begins training to control his kagune.
Touka reluctantly agrees to help him with his training.
Touka's own kagune is an ukaku type, suited for speed.
Kaneki struggles to master his powers.
His emotional state affects the strength of his kagune.
Kaneki learns about the different ghoul factions.
The Aogiri Tree is a violent and extremist ghoul group.
The organization threatens the peace of all ghouls.
Kaneki is warned to stay away from Aogiri Tree.
He begins to feel the pull of his ghoul nature.
Kaneki's transformation becomes more pronounced.

chapters.title: Hatch
content: Kaneki's dual nature continues to torment him.
He dreams of Rize and the day he was attacked.
Rize appears in his mind, mocking and taunting him.
Kaneki struggles to suppress his ghoul instincts.
He realizes that Rize's personality lives within him.
The transplant has made him more than just half-ghoul.
Kaneki fights to maintain his humanity.
The CCG's investigation in the 20th Ward intensifies.
Amon Kotaro, a dedicated investigator, arrives.
Amon is driven by a desire to eliminate all ghouls.
He begins to suspect Anteiku's true nature.
Kaneki must protect his new friends from the CCG.
The pressure of his double life weighs heavily on him.
Kaneki's path becomes increasingly dangerous.

chapters.title: The Doves' Emergence
content: The CCG's presence in the 20th Ward becomes more aggressive.
Amon and Mado investigate the area around Anteiku.
Kaneki and the Anteiku ghouls must be extremely cautious.
The Fueguchi family is targeted by the CCG.
Hinami is forced to flee with Kaneki's help.
Kaneki protects Hinami from the investigators.
Mado and Suzuya capture Hinami during a confrontation.
Kaneki is overcome with guilt and rage.
He blames himself for failing to protect Hinami.
Touka becomes more involved in protecting Anteiku.
The peace of the 20th Ward is shattered by violence.
Kaneki must make difficult choices to survive.
He is no longer a passive victim of his circumstances.
Kaneki takes his first steps toward becoming a fighter.

chapters.title: The Gourmet
content: Kaneki meets Shu Tsukiyama, a ghoul known as the Gourmet.
Tsukiyama is obsessed with the taste of rare and exotic flesh.
He becomes fascinated by Kaneki's half-ghoul nature.
Tsukiyama invites Kaneki to a ghoul gathering.
The gathering is a banquet where ghouls feast on humans.
Kaneki is horrified by the cruelty of the event.
Tsukiyama tries to devour Kaneki at the banquet.
Kaneki is forced to fight for his life against Tsukiyama.
The battle is intense and tests Kaneki's abilities.
Kaneki's rinkaku kagune proves to be powerful.
He defeats Tsukiyama but is left traumatized.
Kaneki's reputation among ghouls begins to grow.
He realizes that he must become even stronger.
The Gourmet arc pushes Kaneki to his limits.

chapters.title: The Aogiri Tree
content: The Aogiri Tree becomes more active and aggressive.
The organization kidnaps Kaneki for their own purposes.
Kaneki is taken to their hideout and tortured.
His torturer is Yamori, a sadistic and powerful ghoul.
Yamori attempts to break Kaneki's will through torture.
Kaneki refuses to surrender his humanity.
His torture pushes him to the brink of madness.
Kaneki is forced to accept his ghoul nature to survive.
He undergoes a terrible transformation in captivity.
Kaneki's hair turns white from the stress and trauma.
He finally embraces his ghoul powers completely.
Kaneki breaks free from his tormentors.
He emerges as a powerful and dangerous figure.
The Ken Kaneki from the past is gone forever.

chapters.title: The Awakening
content: Kaneki has fully transformed into a ruthless and powerful ghoul.
He defeats Yamori and his followers in brutal fashion.
Kaneki's power level is now classified as SS-rated.
He leaves Aogiri Tree and begins his own campaign.
Kaneki wants to destroy the organization that hurt him.
He becomes known as the 'Eyepatch' or 'Centipede'.
Kaneki's actions begin to attract attention from all sides.
The CCG puts him on their highest priority list.
Kaneki's friends are shocked by his transformation.
Touka and the Anteiku ghouls are worried about him.
Kaneki becomes more isolated and dangerous.
He is consumed by his desire for revenge and power.
Kaneki's humanity is fading away.
The new Kaneki is a monster born from suffering.

chapters.title: The Anteiku Raid
content: The CCG launches a massive raid on Anteiku.
The operation is led by the best investigators in Tokyo.
The goal is to eliminate all ghouls in the 20th Ward.
Kaneki returns to Anteiku to defend his friends.
He fights against the CCG investigators.
Kaneki demonstrates his incredible new powers.
He faces Arima Kishou, the CCG's strongest investigator.
Arima is known as the 'Reaper' and never loses.
Kaneki is defeated in a devastating battle.
Arima delivers a fatal blow to Kaneki.
The Anteiku raid ends in tragedy for both sides.
Yoshimura is captured by the CCG.
Many ghouls are killed or arrested.
Kaneki is left for dead as Anteiku burns.

chapters.title: The Aftermath
content: Kaneki is presumed dead after the Anteiku raid.
His friends mourn his loss and remember their time together.
Hide disappears after searching for Kaneki.
The 20th Ward is left in a state of chaos and fear.
Touka and the remaining Anteiku ghouls go into hiding.
Kaneki is actually still alive, but severely injured.
He is taken in by the CCG for experimentation.
Arima sees potential in Kaneki and spares his life.
Kaneki is given a new identity by the CCG.
His memories of his past life are suppressed.
Kaneki becomes Haise Sasaki, a CCG investigator.
He leads a special team called the Quinx.
The sequel to Tokyo Ghoul begins.
Kaneki's story is far from over.
